sources.summary: Creators Damon Beesley and Iain Morris return as writers and directors, with the original cast reprising their roles Netflix has announced that production has begun on a new Inbetweeners film, with the original cast members reprising their roles. It will be a continuation of the popular Channel 4 sitcom, which aired on E4 from 2008 to 2010, followed by two films in 2011 and 2014. Continue reading...
